race.comment: BLISS BOMB (3) has probably been finding 1200m a tad too far recently, and the slight drop in trip can make all the difference to this honest mare. She will have to shoulder 61kg, but this field is not strong, and she will also have the services of Damian Lane for the first time. On top for us. ADKI (10) is a durable veteran who only knows one way, that is scoot to the front. She has the pole position and has won here in the past. Include in all top 4 combos. SMOKE SCREEN (8) battled away soundly for fourth at Kilmore last start, and she will be peaking at the right time for this. She benefits from a 3kg claim and is ready to put her best hoof forward in this. OUR LITTLE STAR (1) may not win often, but she definitely pays her way, with 19 minor placings, including 3 this season. She slides back down in class and should produce her usual honest effort. ENIGMATISE (9) was beaten by half a length into second in BM52 company last start and is another with top 4 claims here.
